evidence_quotes.quote: Task-sharing to promote caregiver mental health, positive parenting practices, and violence prevention in vulnerable families in Sierra Leone: a pilot feasibility study

Research assistants blinded to treatment assignment assessed caregiver mental health, caregiver-child interactions, and household violence at baseline, post-intervention, and 3-month follow-up time points.

raw_response.plain_vs_narrow_note: Both readings exclude the record under E01 because the study concerns a home-visiting behavioural intervention for caregiver mental health, parenting practices, and household violence prevention rather than water or sanitation service access.
raw_response.rationale: This randomized pilot feasibility study evaluates a Community Health Worker home-visiting behavioural intervention targeting caregiver mental health, early childhood development, parenting practices, and household violence in Sierra Leone.
